entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED
entities.description: State entered by a UE after starting the attach or combined attach procedure while waiting for a response from the MME.

entities.name: Attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to register with the network.

entities.name: Combined attach procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to register with the network including combined services.

relations.description: Starting the attach procedure causes the UE to enter EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state.
Starting the combined attach procedure causes the UE to enter EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state.
